en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4491 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Hammad al-Nab, from Abu Basir, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (as) about a man who married a woman with the condition of giving her a well-known orchard that had abundant produce. Then, after remaining for years without consummating the marriage, he divorced her.

Imam (as) said: "He must look at what the orchard has yielded in produce from the day he married her, and he should give her half of it, along with half of the orchard itself, unless she pardons him and agrees to settle for something that pleases her from him,
for that is closer to piety."
